user.title: Sharp NEC cinema projector
user.description: Enter the IP address of the projector head. The cinema control protocol uses TCP port 43728. Leave the projector ID at 0 unless you address several projectors on one control line.

error.cannot_connect: No answer on the control port. Check the IP address and whether external control is enabled on the projector.
error.refused: The projector answered but refused the command.

init.title: Options
init.description: Macros are written as a comma separated list, for example: 1: Flat, 2: Scope, 3: Alternative content. Only the macros you list here appear in the macro select.

select_title.name: Select title
select_title.description: Selects an entry from the projector's title list.

title.name: Title number
title.description: Position in the title list, 0 to 99.

select_macro.name: Select macro
select_macro.description: Presses one of the preset (macro) keys of the projector.

macro.name: Macro key
macro.description: Preset key 1 to 20. Older models support 1 to 8 or 1 to 16.

picture_mute.name: Picture mute
picture_mute.description: Blanks the picture electronically. The douser is not moved.

enabled.name: Muted
enabled.description: Turn the picture mute on or off.

lens_control.name: Lens control
lens_control.description: Drives the lens motor for a short time.

axis.name: Axis
axis.description: Zoom, focus, horizontal shift or vertical shift.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Motor run time in seconds: 0.25, 0.5 or 1.
